# Feedmarkdown test event

This is a sample article sent by the webhook test button. It is not real news and is not stored in your feed.

- Your endpoint received and parsed the payload.
- Verify the `X-Feedmarkdown-Signature` header with your webhook secret.

Real deliveries carry the full article text in this field.
